title: manifest.jsonl — ORGI / Census of India resource
description: One ORGI Census product acquired from the data.gov.in (OGD) API. A record describes ONE catalogue resource: a state for Primary Census Abstract and Town Directory, a district for Village and Town Amenities. `url` is deliberately key-free — the OGD contract puts `api-key` in the query string, so the literal request URL is a credential and must never reach an artefact.

source_name.description: The Census product. `pca` is the Primary Census Abstract — population, households, age 0-6, literates, workers, and Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe counts by person/male/female. `village-amenities` and `town-amenities` are the settlement-level facility tables. `town-directory` is a place INDEX only (codes and names, no amenities).

resource_id.description: The OGD catalogue resource id (`index_name`), stable across pulls.

census_year.description: Census vintage parsed from the catalogue title. Titles carry two formats — `Primary Census Abstract, 2001 - Delhi` and `Primary Census Abstract 2011 - Rajasthan` — so the year is read as a token, not by position. **Null means unparsed, never 2011.**

level.description: What one resource covers, NOT the granularity of its rows: a PCA state resource contains rows down to ward level.

district_name.description: Present for per-district products only. **Census 2011 areas.** Many districts have been created since — all of Telangana, and splits in Gujarat and elsewhere — so a join from current administrative data will silently miss unless it is mediated by a vintage-aware mapping.

url.description: Key-free request URL. A value containing `api-key` is a credential leak, not a provenance record.

dest.description: Path to the acquired rows (JSONL), relative to the corpus root. Null until downloaded.
